target.description: Declared exact-rational software target for quantized-carry, exact KCL and normalized fluid sum, exact-difference, log-domain square-root, arithmetic operations including positive reciprocal, and three-level sign. It is a reference adapter experiment, not a GLM model, a GLM runtime or a performance measurement.

known_valid.rationale: Three cards explicitly declare sqrt support; one is source-simulated and two are structural.
The KCL, fluid and op-amp cards explicitly declare exact-sum support.
The KCL, fluid and op-amp cards explicitly declare exact-difference support.
The delta-sigma card explicitly declares quantized-carry support.
The generated log-domain arithmetic card declares exp through the antilog junction; source and target routes are exercised in D3.
The generated log-domain arithmetic card declares log through the logging junction; source and target routes are exercised in D3.
The generated slide-rule card declares mult as log, log, sum, exp; the positive-domain source and target routes are exercised in D3.
The generated slide-rule card declares div as log, log, neg, sum, exp; the positive-domain source and target routes are exercised in D3.
The generated slide-rule card declares reciprocal as log, neg, exp; the positive-domain source and target routes are exercised in D3.
The threshold-comparator card declares exact three-level sign; the negative, zero and positive branches are exercised by D7.

known_invalid.rationale: The orifice card contains a mult primitive but declares only sqrt support; primitive overlap must not create a transfer.

The cam profile is the sqrt-specific delta; it does not compute a logarithm. The transcendental-identity sibling delta does compute it and is labelled separately. Refusing the wrong delta remains the control: naming a support for log that lacks the log junction is not a transfer.

The cam profile is the sqrt-specific delta; it does not compute an exponential. The transcendental-identity sibling delta does compute it and is labelled separately. Refusing the wrong delta remains the control: primitive or domain overlap must not create a transfer.
A fluid junction conserves flow; it does not supply a product law. Primitive or domain overlap must not be accepted as multiplication.
Delta-sigma is a quantized-carry mechanism; it must not appear for sqrt merely because both are nonlinear operations.
The PLL card is stateful and feedback-based but supports phase and frequency operations, not quantized carry.

refused.rationale: The negative-control name from the transfer specification has no production operation contract.
A generic multiplier must not be accepted as a matrix-vector transfer; this name has no production contract.
The PLL card declares this source operation, but no production operation contract or target adapter exists, so retrieval refuses it.
